name: komdosh-dev-spring-core
description: The foundation for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux services: implementing, verifying, and reviewing code inside one service — including its Kafka/SQS consumers and Avro schemas, which answer to the same hexagonal and coroutine rules. Enforces the 12 forbidden coroutine patterns, hexagonal module boundaries, RFC 9457 errors, application-layer PII handling, consumer idempotency and DLQ policy, and Avro schema/registry discipline. Grep-based preflight skills catch the mechanical violations in seconds, before a full Gradle cycle.
